title: TypeScript SDK Validation Nuxt integration Docker build fails deterministically at 'RUN npm ci'
error_pattern: ERROR: failed to solve: process "/bin/sh -c npm ci" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1 (Dockerfile step 6: RUN npm run build, step 5: COPY . .). Occurs building the generated Nuxt 'web' publish image after the TypeScript validation AppHosts themselves pass (59/59) and the Nuxt integration test (test-nuxt-integration.sh, playground/NuxtApp) runs its 'aspire publish' + docker build step.
